stories.title: Attacks and escalation around Hormuz
stories.what: Attacks on commercial shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz continue. Two further tanker incidents were reported near Oman and a vessel struck a mine east of Hormuz, after UKMTO said a tanker was hit by a projectile and caught fire while outbound through the strait.
stories.why_it_matters: Hull strikes and mines raise war-risk premiums for Arabian Gulf liftings, slow transits and shrink the pool of willing owners, reshaping crude, product and gas ton-miles.
stories.latest: gCaptain reported two tanker incidents near Oman and a mine strike east of Hormuz; Banchero Costa reported Arabian Gulf crude exports down 27.6% year to date on the war in Iran.
sources: Two Tanker Incidents Reported Near Oman; Vessel Hit Mine East Of Hormuz
Tanker On Fire After Struck By Projectile Near Strait of Hormuz
Tanker Market: Arabian Gulf Crude Oil Exports Down 27.6% This Year

stories.title: Drone strikes on shipping in the Baltic and Gulf of Finland
stories.what: The Russian RoRo Sparta II, linked to military logistics, was struck by a suspected drone on Saturday while sailing in the Baltic, catching fire and drifting into Finnish territorial waters.
stories.why_it_matters: Attacks in the Baltic extend the risk zone for merchant shipping well beyond the Black Sea, with implications for war-risk cover, routing and port calls in Northern Europe.
stories.latest: First reported strike: Sparta II abandoned and burning in the Gulf of Finland after a suspected drone attack.
sources: Russian Military RoRo Abandoned After Drone Attack in the Baltic
Russian Military-Linked Cargo Ship Burns After Suspected Drone Strike in Gulf of Finland

stories.title: Attacks on shipping in the Black Sea
stories.what: Drone strikes on merchant ships in the Black Sea have continued through November, with two vessels sunk off Bulgaria and crew injured following an earlier wheat carrier capsizing.
stories.why_it_matters: Strikes on ships and port infrastructure threaten grain and dry bulk loadings and add insurance and routing costs for any vessel calling in the region.

stories.title: Russian refining damage and diesel export limits
stories.what: Ukrainian drone attacks have cut Russian refineries' combined crude processing by 45% since late October, on top of a Russian ban on most diesel exports extended to end-January.
stories.why_it_matters: Lost Russian refining and export restrictions reshape clean product ton-miles, pulling diesel from longer-haul sources and changing MR and LR employment.

stories.title: Sanctions and evasion in the shadow fleet
stories.what: Sanctions pressure on the shadow fleet is widening, with EU measures targeting shipowners, managers, insurers and financial networks, adding to earlier US designations. The Russian Navy is reported escorting sanctioned dark-fleet tankers in the Mediterranean.
stories.why_it_matters: Designations force charterers and underwriters to re-verify counterparties and vessel positions, and naval escorting signals that sanctioned trades are being defended rather than curtailed.

stories.title: US-China ship fees and port state control friction
stories.what: The US has extended its suspension of port fees targeting Chinese-built and Chinese-operated vessels for another two months while trade talks continue, while a US congressional committee urges sanctions over China's detention of Panama-flagged ships.
stories.why_it_matters: Reinstated fees, sanctions or retaliatory detentions would change the cost and risk of deploying particular tonnage into US and Chinese trades.
